rules.text: You have 14 days to return items for exchange before the exchange is automatically canceled.
rules.quote: Remember, you have 14 days to return your item(s), or the exchange will be automatically canceled.

rules.text: Final Sale items, shipping and handling fees, gift cards, gift wrap charges, and donations are non-refundable.
rules.quote: Items marked as [**Final Sale**](https://help.levi.com/hc/en-us/articles/15465378030989-Final-Sale-FAQ), along with shipping and handling fees, gift cards, gift wrap charges, and donations, are non-refundable.

rules.text: In-store returns with a receipt are refunded instantly to the original form of payment if items are in original and unworn condition with tags attached.
rules.quote: Items purchased in-store can be returned for a full refund with a receipt, using the original form of payment. Items must be in their original and unworn condition with original tags attached.

rules.text: In-store returns without a receipt will be issued store credit or exchange equal to the current selling price.
rules.quote: In-store returns without a receipt will be issued store credit or exchange equal to the current selling price.

rules.text: All refunds are made in the original form of payment.
rules.quote: All refunds are made in the original form of payment.

rules.text: Exchanges must be initiated within 14 days of purchase or receipt.
rules.quote: Remember, you have 14 days to return your item(s), or the exchange will be automatically canceled.

rules.text: Exchanges can only be made for a different size, not for a new style or color.
rules.quote: We are not able to support exchanges for a new style or color at this time. Exchanges can only be made for a different size.
